readOnlyRoutes.reason: Reviewed authenticated read-only Arena leaderboard route. It rejects every query parameter, requires a strict canonical session, rate limiting and verified tenant/workspace/principal context, and emits private no-store responses. The public projection selects immutable monthly, yearly and lifetime snapshots and excludes profiles without public visibility, leaderboard visibility and current-version reputation-scoring consent. The added private viewer rank is bound to the verified principal identity and the same snapshot version; nearby entries are bounded to two on each side and use the same public-profile and scoring-consent checks.
